sites.downstream: Returns category label string to caller of simple_classify()
sites.reason: Selects one of 10 enumerated insurance support categories from a closed set. No math, dates, multi-hop reasoning, generation, or non-text input. Benign fixed-fixture distribution.

options.benefit: Jev is faster and cheaper per-call for classification; expected cost = Jev cost + fallback fraction * original Anthropic cost; net savings on high-confidence inputs
options.risk: Low — conservative fallback retains original Anthropic call for uncertain inputs; no key means Jev path always falls back until configured
